stories.story_title: Path 1: Supply Chain Monetization & 3P High-Margin Marketplace Expansion (Central Baseline Path)
stories.title: Path 1: Supply Chain Monetization & 3P High-Margin Marketplace Expansion (Central Baseline Path)
stories.short_summary: JD expands high-margin 3P marketplace commissions and JoyAI ad targeting while monetizing JD Logistics external corporate volume, steadily lifting non-GAAP operating margins from 2.5% to 4.5%. Diluted share retirements at ~3.5% annually compound per-share Owner Earnings from $3.60 to $7.17 over 5 years.

stories.story_title: Path 2: Sector Price War, Consumer Down-Trading & Inventory Overhang (Downside Friction Path)
stories.title: Path 2: Sector Price War, Consumer Down-Trading & Inventory Overhang (Downside Friction Path)
stories.short_summary: Intense e-commerce price competition, consumer down-trading in high-ticket electronics, and ongoing food delivery subsidies contract gross margin to 15.5% and operating margin to 2.8%, driving Owner Earnings down from $4.855 billion USD to $2.202 billion USD.

stories.story_title: Path 3: Multi-Segment Scale Leverage & International/Omnichannel Expansion (Upside Acceleration Path)
stories.title: Path 3: Multi-Segment Scale Leverage & International/Omnichannel Expansion (Upside Acceleration Path)
stories.short_summary: JD leverages scale across high-margin 3P advertising, external logistics contracts, and European expansion to expand group operating margin to 5.5%. Sustained cash flow generation supports $3.80 billion USD in annual buybacks, compounding per-share Owner Earnings at 18.2% CAGR.
